SECRET-LITERAL.rationale: Potential credential material in source relates to credentials-in-files exposure. This does not establish credential validity, attacker activity or an executed technique.

ROLE-STATUS.rationale: Declared role/status mismatch supports authorization review; response content and business authorization are not confirmed.

CORS-CREDENTIALS.rationale: Credentialed synthetic-origin preflight reflection supports CORS review; browser exploitability remains unverified.

HTTP-HSTS.rationale: Observed HSTS response-header absence; policy coverage requires manual review.

COOKIE-FLAGS.rationale: Cookie-attribute observation; purpose and session sensitivity require review.
